_about: Skill reminders. When a prompt matches a pattern (case-insensitive regex) and does not already name a skill, the AI asks the user whether to use that skill, at most once per skill per session. Read by scripts/hooks/skill_nudge.py (Claude Code) and by AGENTS.md (other AIs). Keep docs/skills.md in sync when you edit this file.
